15:1.text: [These letters are one of the miracles of the Qur’ân, and none but Allâh (Alone) knows their meanings]
.These are Verses of the Book and a plain Qur’ân.

15:2.text: How much would those who disbelieved wish that they had been Muslims

[those who have submitted themselves to Allâh’s Will in Islâm i.e. Islâmic Monotheism - this will be on the Day of Resurrection when they will see the disbelievers going to Hell and the Muslims going to Paradise]

15:3.text: Leave them to eat and enjoy, and let them be preoccupied with
hope. They will come to know!

15:4.text: And never did We destroy a township but there was a known decree for it.

15:5.text: No nation can advance its term, nor delay it.

15:6.text: has been sent down! Verily, you are a mad man!

15:7.text: "Why do you not bring angels to us if you are of the truthful?"

15:8.text: We send not the angels down except with the truth

15:9.text: Verily, We, it is We Who have sent down the Dhikr
and surely, We will guard it

15:10.text: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم)

15:11.text: And never came a Messenger to them but they did mock at him.

15:12.text: enter the hearts of the Mujrimûn
[criminals, polytheists and pagans (because of their mocking at the Messengers)]

15:13.text: They would not believe in it

15:14.text: And even if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they were to keep on ascending thereto

15:15.text: (we have not seen any angel or heaven)
. Nay, we are a people bewitched."
